title: Payout Methods Re-Send Float by Time on File: Questions Answered
content:
**What decides the re-send float?** The re-send float is the part of a reactivated Payout Methods method's held balance that a re-send leaves for the next scheduled run, and it depends on how long the method has been on file, counted in whole months from its date added: for a method on file at least 48 months the float is the largest rail fee ever charged on the method; for one on file at least 24 but fewer than 48 months it is 1.00 percent of the held balance less the holdbacks and the conversion buffer; for a newer method it is not set by time on file.

**Which date starts the count?** The date added on the payout method's record. A later re-verification, such as the one after a return, does not restart it. The count runs to the day of the re-send, in whole months.

**How do the bands read?**

| Whole months from the method's date added to the re-send | Re-send float |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | The largest rail fee ever charged on the method |
| 24 to 47 | 1.00 percent of the held balance less the holdbacks and the conversion buffer |
| Fewer than 24 | Not set by time on file |

**What is "the largest rail fee ever charged"?** The highest single rail fee entry on the method's ledger over its whole history: a transfer fee, a cross-currency fee or a returned-payout fee.

**What is the 1.00 percent taken on?** On the held balance after the holdback percentages and the conversion buffer have been taken off it, unrounded.

**Where are the lines?** With an imagined re-send on 2026-08-20: a method added on 2022-08-20 has 48 whole months and takes the largest-fee float; one added on 2022-08-21 has 47 and takes the 1.00 percent float; one added on 2024-08-20 has 24 and takes the 1.00 percent float; one added on 2024-08-21 has 23.

**A hypothetical figure.** An imagined method on file 30 whole months has a held balance of USD 5120.00, holdbacks of USD 409.60 and a conversion buffer of USD 38.30. The held balance less those is USD 4672.10, and the float is 1.00 percent of it, USD 46.721, carried unrounded.
